observations: Three photos show corrugated metal roofing sheets laid out on a concrete floor.
The sheets have a wavy, ribbed profile typical of roofing materials.
The color is a uniform light brown or beige, with a matte or semi-gloss finish.
The watermark 'SOLANA ALUMINUM' is visible on all three photos, suggesting the brand or seller name.
Photo 0 shows a close-up of a single sheet, highlighting the wave pattern and surface texture.
Photo 1 shows a longer section of the sheet, with a red plastic chair and some machinery in the background.
Photo 2 shows multiple sheets stacked or laid side by side, with some darker sheets visible at the bottom edge.
No visible damage, dents, or rust on the sheets in the photos.
The seller mentions 'Oven-Baked aluminium Steptiles and Metcopo roofing sheet', but no such branding is visible on the sheets themselves.

claims.claim: High quality Oven-Baked aluminium Steptiles and Metcopo roofing sheet
claims.evidence: The watermark 'SOLANA ALUMINUM' is visible, but no 'Steptiles' or 'Metcopo' branding is visible on the sheets. The 'Oven-Baked' claim cannot be verified remotely.
No thickness markings or measurements are visible on the sheets. Thickness cannot be determined from photos alone.

risks.risk: The material may not be aluminium or may be of lower quality than claimed.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the edge or cross-section of the sheet showing the material thickness and composition, or a lab test report.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic metal roofing, not premium aluminium

risks.risk: The 'Oven-Baked' coating may not be present or may be of poor quality, affecting durability.
risks.proof: A close-up of the surface under UV light or a scratch test to check coating integrity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard painted metal, not oven-baked

risks.risk: The sheets may be damaged or have hidden defects not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the entire length of a sheet being bent or flexed to check for cracks or warping.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged or lower grade

proof_requests: Close-up of the edge or cross-section of a sheet to verify material and thickness.
A video showing the sheet being bent to check for flexibility and defects.
Proof of the 'Oven-Baked' coating, such as a scratch test or lab report.
Clear shot of any product label or specification tag on the sheet.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as corrugated roofing sheet, but key claims about material quality, coating, and thickness cannot be verified from the photos. Without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately and risks being misclassified as premium when it may be standard or lower quality.
